event: "Let's do the ring. I like to keep my hands free," Nala says.
"Anything we can do to make it stronger? I've gold to spare, up to fifty. What options do you have?"
Ilse settles her spectacles. "Plain ring, I'll have it set by the afternoon of day ten."

memory.fact: Ilse can have the plain ring set by the afternoon of day 10.

event: "The honest part first: a focus buys reach, or holds mana. The force is all yours to bring."

memory.fact: Ilse says no focus adds force to a working; a focus buys reach, or holds mana, nothing more.

event: "Reach counts for held workings. Loosed beams, slugs and bullets fly as far as they ever did."

memory.fact: A focus lengthens held workings only; loosed beams, slugs and bullets fly no farther for it.

event: She lifts a second pearl from a case. "Mine. Beside yours, two pearls reach seventy yards."

memory.fact: Ilse has a drake-pearl of her own; set beside Nala's in the ring, two pearls reach 70 yards.

event: "Seven gold, setting included, and a day more on the ring."

memory.fact: Ilse's second pearl costs 7 gold, setting included, and adds a day to the ring.

event: A tray holds a dull grey stone. "A well-stone. Twenty gold, three days more. Holds forty mana."

memory.fact: Ilse can set a well-stone in the band for 20 gold; it adds three days to the ring.

event: "Fill it from your own, ten a minute, easy. Draw on it, and the forty is back in half a minute."

memory.fact: A well-stone holds 40 mana; its wearer fills it from her own at 10 a minute, with no roll.
Drawing a full well-stone gives back its 40 mana over half a minute, with no check.

event: "Half up front covers the extras too; the rest when I hand the ring over."

memory.fact: Ilse's half up front covers extras too; the rest is paid when the ring is handed over.

event: "Band metal's all one to a focus. And I set at my own pace, whatever you pay."

memory.fact: Ilse will not hurry a setting, and says a band's metal makes no difference to a focus.

event: Ilse folds her inky hands on the counter. "So. Plain, second pearl, well-stone, or both?"
